entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Rá andiatene, unindano sun, dejano ón ri andiatene. Rapitá quantanani Ungé Rapitá doterá Ungé tunshondá ne andietané datera ne tratén i criquitin.
 Yqi sauchera Unge uirri qui saucherá unindeno Sunú chera unicho sansiquiti unichera ninda.
